title: Prompt Quality Evaluator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Prompt Engineering
description: A calibration exercise where students rate five prompt and response pairs on relevance, accuracy, completeness, and conciseness, then compare their ratings against expert scores.

learningObjectives: Assess the quality of AI prompts and responses using the four evaluation dimensions
prerequisites: The four quality dimensions: relevance, accuracy, completeness, conciseness

keyQuestions: Which dimension catches a fluent but factually wrong response?
Can a response score 10 on accuracy and 2 on completeness?
assessmentOpportunities: Rate a new pair within 2 points of expert on three of four dimensions
Name which dimension a given failure belongs to
